signals.derivation: Replatform verdict: container-native TypeScript Express stack (INV-01); stateless compute pattern; Prisma ORM and BullMQ portable to OTC equivalents. Primary blocker: EGR-01 AWS Comprehend Medical has no sovereign equivalent -- feature disable or self-hosted NLP required before OTC cutover. GDPR Art. 9 health data residency mandates migration from current AWS EU tenancy.

Refactor rejected: BYOK is post-migration remediation (CRYPTO-04), not a pre-condition for Replatform; structured logging hardening is pre-migration not architectural rework. Re-architect rejected: Express+Postgres+Redis+S3 maps directly to OTC sovereign equivalents without structural change.

Migration gate: AWS Comprehend Medical (EGR-01) processes FHIR health records -- no BSI C5 certified sovereign equivalent available. Recommended path: disable Comprehend Medical feature pre-migration; implement lightweight on-premise NLP post-migration. DiGA audit certification requires sovereign compute environment.

assessment.migration_rationale: Container-native TypeScript stack with stateless compute is cloud-portable. AWS Comprehend Medical (EGR-01) is the sole hard migration gate. DiGA health-data regulatory requirement mandates sovereign compute. Post-migration items: BYOK implementation (CRYPTO-04), structured logging (TF-06).
recommended_next_steps: Resolve EGR-01: disable Comprehend Medical feature or identify self-hosted NLP alternative
Stand up OTC eu-de-1 tenant via meshStack and configure health-sovereign landing zone
Implement BYOK key management post-migration (CRYPTO-04) for BSI C5 compliance
Add structured JSON logging (TF-06) before cutover for sovereign observability stack
